# Skin Cycle

> A private skin diary with skincare tips for each phase of the menstrual cycle, checked against 67 sources. A portfolio project by Sonali Krishnani (M.Sc. Microbiology, registered Biology teacher, Limerick, Ireland), built with Claude Code. Not medical advice.

## Pages
- [Landing page](https://shonalikrishnani-git.github.io/skin-cycle/): what the app does and how it works
- [Demo](https://shonalikrishnani-git.github.io/skin-cycle/app/?tour): a five-step guided demo with a sample diary
- [Case study](https://shonalikrishnani-git.github.io/skin-cycle/about.html): the problem, Sonali's role, how the advice was checked, key decisions
- [Rapid review](https://shonalikrishnani-git.github.io/skin-cycle/research.html): AI-assisted rapid review of 47 studies with GRADE ratings; screening and extraction by AI agents, directed by Sonali Krishnani

## Key facts
- Only self-reported premenstrual acne flares reach low certainty; other skin changes across the cycle are very low certainty.
- No study or registered trial has compared cycle-timed skincare with a steady routine.
- Every tip in the app links to at least one of 67 sources (AAD, NHS, HSE, DermNet, FDA, PubMed studies).
